newsitem.title: USA: PS Enterprise net up on non-utility effort.
newsitem.headline: PS Enterprise net up on non-utility effort.

text.p: Public Service Enterprise Group Inc Tuesday reported third quarter earnings of $0.85 per share, compared to $0.76 a year earlier, saying the improved results stemmed largely from relatively strong non-utility performance.

It cited two businesses, Community Energy Alternatives Inc, an independent power production company, and Public Service Resources Corp, an investment company, as well as a one-time gain of $13.5 million, or $0.06 per share, from the sale of its non-utility oil and gas business, Energy Development Corp.

The company said quarterly results were helped by cost-management activities at its utility business, Public Service Electric & Gas Co which helped offset, to a considerable degree, weaker electric sales due to cooler summer weather this year.

PSE&G's electric sales in the third quarter decreased 5.2% when compared to sales for the same period in 1995, with residential, commercial, and industrial sales down 4.6%, 4.2%, and 8.3%, respectively.

Electric sales for the first nine months of 1996 decreased 0.6% when compared to sales for the same period in 1995. Residential and commercial sales were up 0.2% and 0.9% respectively, while industrial sales declined 4.5%.
